note: 农事日历：按月给出主栽作物的关键农事。用于终端端农事提醒与问答引用，具体日期请按当地气候前移或后移 7~15 天。

zh-CN: 返青期追施返青肥，亩施尿素 10~15 公斤
防治纹枯病，重点喷茎基部
拔节前化控防倒伏
en-US: Top-dress at greening, 10-15 kg urea per mu
Control sheath blight, spray the stem base
Growth regulation before jointing to prevent lodging

zh-CN: 拔节孕穗期追肥，控氮增钾
防治白粉病、锈病
注意防治麦蚜和红蜘蛛
en-US: Top-dress at jointing/booting, less N more K
Control powdery mildew and rust
Watch for wheat aphids and spider mites

zh-CN: 抽穗扬花期喷药防赤霉病，遇雨要补喷
叶面喷 0.2% 磷酸二氢钾防早衰
灌浆水要小水勤浇，避免大水漫灌
en-US: Spray for fusarium head blight at heading/flowering, repeat after rain
Foliar 0.2% monopotassium phosphate to delay senescence
Light frequent irrigation at grain filling

zh-CN: 适时收获，蜡熟末期最合适
收获后及时晾晒入库
麦茬地尽早翻耕灭茬
en-US: Harvest at late dough stage
Dry and store promptly
Plough stubble land early

zh-CN: 麦收后抢时播种，争取 6 月 15 日前完成
种肥同播，注意种肥隔离防烧种
播后浇蒙头水，保证出苗
en-US: Sow immediately after wheat harvest, finish before 15 June
Seed and fertiliser together, keep them separated to avoid burn
Irrigate after sowing for uniform emergence

zh-CN: 3~5 叶期间苗定苗
拔节期追攻秆肥
防治玉米螟，心叶末期灌心
en-US: Thin and fix plant density at 3-5 leaves
Top-dress at jointing
Control corn borer by treating the whorl at late whorl stage

zh-CN: 大喇叭口期追攻穗肥
防治大斑病、小斑病
注意防旱防涝，及时排积水
en-US: Ear fertiliser at late whorl
Control northern and southern leaf blight
Manage drought and waterlogging, drain ponding

zh-CN: 灌浆期叶面喷肥延长功能叶寿命
适当晚收，苞叶变黄后 7~10 天收获产量最高
收获后秸秆还田或青贮
en-US: Foliar feed at grain filling to keep leaves functional
Delay harvest 7-10 days after husks yellow for top yield
Return residues to soil or ensile

zh-CN: 秧田期注意防治稻飞虱和稻蓟马
移栽前 3~5 天施送嫁肥
适龄移栽，秧龄控制在 30 天左右
en-US: Control planthoppers and thrips in the seedbed
Apply transplanting fertiliser 3-5 days before
Transplant at about 30 days seedling age

zh-CN: 返青后浅水勤灌促分蘖
分蘖肥在移栽后 7~10 天施
防治二化螟
en-US: Shallow frequent irrigation after establishment
Tiller fertiliser 7-10 days after transplanting
Control striped stem borer

zh-CN: 分蘖末期适时晒田，控制无效分蘖
晒田后复水追穗肥
重点防治稻瘟病和稻飞虱
en-US: Drain at late tillering to suppress unproductive tillers
Re-flood and apply ear fertiliser
Focus on rice blast and planthoppers

zh-CN: 破口期喷药防稻瘟病和穗颈瘟
齐穗期再喷一次
注意防治稻纵卷叶螟
en-US: Spray at boot breaking against blast and neck blast
Spray again at full heading
Control leaf folder

zh-CN: 灌浆期保持干湿交替，忌过早断水
叶面喷磷酸二氢钾促灌浆
稻穗低头后及时排水晒田
en-US: Alternate wetting and drying at filling; do not cut water early
Foliar monopotassium phosphate to boost filling
Drain when panicles bend down

zh-CN: 定植后控水蹲苗，促根下扎
棚温白天 25~28℃、夜间 15℃ 左右
预防灰霉病和晚疫病
en-US: Restrict water after transplanting to encourage deep roots
Keep greenhouse at 25-28C day, about 15C night
Prevent grey mould and late blight

zh-CN: 第一穗果坐住后开始追肥浇水
吊蔓整枝，及时打杈
用熊蜂或振荡器辅助授粉
en-US: Start fertigation once the first truss sets
Train vines and remove side shoots promptly
Use bumblebees or vibration for pollination

zh-CN: 盛果期每采一次果追一次肥
重点防治早疫病、叶霉病和白粉虱
及时打掉下部老叶病叶
en-US: Fertigate after each harvest round at peak fruiting
Target early blight, leaf mould and whitefly
Remove lower old and diseased leaves

zh-CN: 高温期加大通风，遮阳降温
小水勤浇，避免中午浇水
注意防治病毒病，及时拔除病株
en-US: Increase ventilation and shade in hot weather
Irrigate little and often, never at midday
Watch for virus diseases and rogue out infected plants
